answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design already addresses this via Gap 11 in the Context/gaps section. Gap 11 explicitly documents the scenario: after `skip_until_stage` is cleared when the from-stage target unit is found, `resume_mode` remains `true`, causing the resume skip guard to activate for all subsequent stages marked complete. The fix is specified in the Decision paragraph: "in both dispatch-unit arms (cycle:* and stage:*) of `main()` in runner.sh, immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage`, also set `resume_mode=false` immediately." The steps block includes this fix ("also set `resume_mode=false` immediately: `[[ -n "$skip_until_stage" ]] && { skip_until_stage=""; resume_mode=false; }`"). DSFSTG-3[code] pins the observable behavior: a 3-unit fixture [intake (leaf), cyc (cycle), verify (leaf)] with all three stages marked complete, invoked with `--resume --from-stage cyc`, must still dispatch verify even though it was marked complete — this test fails on the old code (verify skipped because `resume_mode` stays `true`) and passes after the fix. Finding 30 and Finding 31 in the Findings section both explicitly confirm this is fully addressed.
